name: 燕羽 · 燕翎风弓
design: A cool graceful SWALLOW-WING WIND BOW: lean elegant INK-TEAL laminated wooden bow with two broad sweeping JADE feather-shaped outer limb faces, each a SINGLE integrated tapering plane (not many feathers), slim muted bronze line at central joint, pale sage small tip caps. Continuous silhouette like a swallow's wing arc with slightly upswept beak-like solid tips; NO branches/forks, no extra wings, no fantasy protrusions interrupting bowstring. Dark central leather grip. SINGLE taut straight dark string. Arrow straight dark shaft, narrow silver-green long LEAF arrowhead, SAGE and INK-BLUE feather fletching shaped like small swallow tail feathers with clear rear nock. Quiver's three arrows match these feathers, one broad jade feather badge on existing quiver. Visual rhythm fluid, narrow and sweeping, obvious teal/green rather than ordinary brown bow.
